AppDescription: See which WSL distros are running, and start or stop them from the system tray.
distro.files-tip: Browse the distro's files in File Explorer (starts the distro if it's stopped)
distro.make-default-tip: Make this the distro that plain wsl opens
distro.missing: This distro is no longer installed.
distro.stop-no-systemd: It doesn't run systemd, so Stop ends it immediately and programs get no warning.
distro.stop-systemd: Stop shuts it down cleanly with systemd: services stop in order and programs get a chance to exit.
distro.stop-timed-out: It didn't finish shutting down within {{minutes}} minutes. Force stop ends it immediately.
distro.stop-unknown: Whether Stop can shut it down cleanly is checked the first time it runs.
distro.terminal-tip: Open a shell in your home folder (starts the distro if it's stopped)
list.no-wsl: WSL isn't installed on this PC.
overview.confirm-none: No distros are running; this only shuts down WSL's virtual machine.
overview.confirm-some: {{names}} will shut down cleanly, then WSL's virtual machine stops. Everything running in WSL ends.
overview.force-body: {{names}} didn't finish shutting down within {{minutes}} minutes. Shutting down now ends whatever is still running there without warning.
overview.shutdown-desc: Stops every running distro cleanly, then shuts down WSL's virtual machine to free its memory.
power.force-tip: {{name}} didn't finish shutting down within {{minutes}} minutes. Force stop ends it immediately; programs still running get no warning.
power.stop-tip-no-systemd: {{name}} doesn't run systemd, so it is stopped immediately and programs get no warning.
power.stop-tip-systemd: Shuts {{name}} down cleanly: services stop and programs get a chance to exit. Everything running in it stops.
power.stop-tip-unknown: Stops {{name}}. Everything running in it stops.
promo.immichdrive: ImmichDrive brings your self-hosted Immich photo and video library straight into Windows File Explorer as a native cloud drive. Your whole timeline appears as files you can...
promo.little-launcher: Little Launcher puts your apps, websites and web pages one click away, in a flyout that opens from the system tray or the taskbar.
promo.printstream: Manage your 3D printers, one or a whole farm, from any device.
promo.repilot: Make your Copilot key actually useful.
promo.store-subtitle: More from Dynamic Solutions Canada on the Microsoft Store.
promo.title: Our other apps
settings.system-distros: Show Docker Desktop's internal distros (Docker Desktop manages these itself)
shutdown.in-progress: A shutdown is already in progress.
shutdown.stuck: {{names}} didn't stop cleanly; WSL was left running.
status.unresponsive: WSL isn't responding; showing last known state
wslconfig.default: Started distros stop again shortly after nothing is running in them (WSL's default idle timeout). Set instanceIdleTimeout=-1 under [general] in .wslconfig to keep them running.
wslconfig.keep: Started distros keep running until you stop them (instanceIdleTimeout=-1 in .wslconfig).
wslconfig.timeout: Started distros stop again after {{seconds}} s with nothing running in them (instanceIdleTimeout in .wslconfig). Set it to -1 to keep them running.
